verdict.rationale: Zero's own docs list AI capabilities over the user's mailbox: asking questions about mailbox content and specific threads, and AI-assisted composition. The founder also describes auto-categorization, thread summaries, drafted replies, and chatting with the inbox. However, the documented capabilities appear in the MCP capability list rather than as in-product features, and proactive insights and suggestions rest only on the founder's community post. Missing for 10: first-party docs for in-app AI insights and summaries, documented proactive suggestions derived from user data, and independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ask questions about specific email threads
auto-categorizes, summarizes threads, drafts replies, and lets users chat with their inbox
